boss-careless.desc: a platform attendant in an orange vest

boss-careful.desc: a platform attendant in an orange vest

go-between-bartender.desc: a platform sweeper with a cart

red-herring-night-courier.desc: a rider with a cloth bag

red-herring-bath-regular.desc: a regular from the bath house

s5-lurker.desc: a young man in a gray coat

s4-thief.desc: a man in a gray hood

s1-mugger.desc: a thin man in a green knit scarf

extra:commuter.desc: a commuter with a black umbrella

extra:claimant.desc: a commuter in a rain jacket

extra:cousin.desc: a stranger in a knit cap

extra:shopper.desc: a commuter with a shoulder bag

platform-morning.1.1.line: {inside-officer} and {framed-officer} walk the platform together on morning patrol.

platform-morning.1.2.line: {boss-careless} waves from beside the lost property bin.

platform-morning.1.5.line: {boss-careless} hands {inside-officer} a paper cup, and no coin changes hands.

platform-morning.1.6.line: {framed-officer} writes the time in a small paper notebook.

platform-morning.1.7.line: {informant} stands at the tag drawer, looks at {boss-careless}, then at the floor.

green-tag-umbrella.1.1.line: {extra:commuter} steps off the morning train, a black umbrella over one arm.

green-tag-umbrella.1.2.line: {extra:commuter} hands the black umbrella to {informant} at the lost property window.

green-tag-umbrella.1.3.line: {informant} ties a green tag to the umbrella handle and sets it in the bin.

green-tag-umbrella.1.4.line: {boss-careless} stands alone at the lost property bin before the window opens.

green-tag-umbrella.1.5.line: {boss-careless} turns the bin key and looks inside while the clerk window is still shuttered.

bench-handoff-early-rider.1.1.line: {extra:passenger} sits on bench 3 holding a folded-over paper bag.

bench-handoff-early-rider.1.2.line: {extra:passenger} hands the paper bag to {go-between-courier} without looking up.

bench-handoff-early-rider.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} reads the departures board, paper bag in hand.

bench-handoff-early-rider.1.4.line: {go-between-courier} walks to the lift instead of the stairs.

bench-handoff-early-rider.1.5.line: {red-herring-night-courier} stands alone on the empty platform before dawn, a cloth bag in hand.

bench-handoff-early-rider.1.6.line: {red-herring-night-courier} waits outside the stair door, the cloth bag held close.

roster-on-the-screens.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} stands at the front screens at the start of shift.

roster-on-the-screens.1.2.line: Posted to the screens by {desk-sergeant}: "Roster change. Officer {inside-officer} and Officer {framed-officer} to metro patrol from tomorrow."

roster-on-the-screens.1.3.line: {framed-officer} reads the roster notice once, then again from the top.

roster-on-the-screens.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} tells {framed-officer} that {inside-officer} asked for the swap last week.

roster-on-the-screens.1.6.line: {framed-officer} shrugs and looks back at the roster.

thin-bag-claim-at-the-bin.1.1.line: {red-herring-bath-regular} waits outside the platform stair door, a thin bag under one arm.

thin-bag-claim-at-the-bin.1.2.line: {red-herring-bath-regular} hands the thin bag to {extra:cousin} and walks off.

thin-bag-claim-at-the-bin.2.1.line: {extra:claimant} comes down the stairs onto the platform.

thin-bag-claim-at-the-bin.2.2.line: {extra:claimant} takes the black umbrella with the green tag from the bin and shows no ticket.

thin-bag-claim-at-the-bin.2.3.line: {boss-careless} waves {extra:claimant} through without asking for a ticket.

thin-bag-claim-at-the-bin.2.4.line: {extra:claimant} carries the closed umbrella by its middle, arm dipping under its weight.

bench-lunch-runner.1.1.line: {informant} and {veteran-officer} sit on the same platform bench at lunch.

bench-lunch-runner.1.2.line: {informant} and {veteran-officer} eat side by side without talking.

bench-lunch-runner.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} says to {informant}: "Last month on this loop for me."

bench-lunch-runner.1.4.line: {informant} gets up and leaves, a paper tag stub tucked under the empty cup.

bench-lunch-runner.2.1.line: {rookie-officer} runs after {red-herring-night-courier} along the dark platform.

bench-lunch-runner.2.2.line: {red-herring-night-courier} runs for the stairs, cloth bag swinging.

bench-lunch-runner.2.3.line: {veteran-officer} catches up at the stairs and tells {rookie-officer}: "Leave it a day."

scan-skipped.1.1.line: {inside-officer} and {framed-officer} walk the platform on morning patrol.

scan-skipped.1.2.line: {framed-officer} scans the north stair door with the handheld.

scan-skipped.1.3.line: {inside-officer} walks past the lost property bin without scanning it.

scan-skipped.1.4.line: {boss-careless} hands {inside-officer} a paper cup across the bin.

scan-skipped.1.5.line: {framed-officer} says to {inside-officer}: "We turned left here yesterday."

scan-skipped.1.6.line: {inside-officer} shrugs and sips from the paper cup.

envelope-lifted-at-the-sky-mall.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} walks along the sky mall concourse at a steady clip.

envelope-lifted-at-the-sky-mall.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} writes in a notebook while walking, head down.

envelope-lifted-at-the-sky-mall.1.3.line: {s4-thief} bumps into {extra:shopper} at a kiosk and mutters a sorry.

envelope-lifted-at-the-sky-mall.1.4.line: {s4-thief} lifts a brown envelope from the shoulder bag of {extra:shopper}.

envelope-lifted-at-the-sky-mall.1.5.line: {s4-thief} runs for the lift, the envelope under {s4-thief.his} jacket.

envelope-lifted-at-the-sky-mall.1.6.line: {rookie-officer} runs after {s4-thief}, notebook still in hand.

envelope-lifted-at-the-sky-mall.1.7.line: {extra:shopper} tells {rookie-officer} the envelope held lost property tags.

knock-at-5d.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} comes through the tenement lobby with a paper bag.

knock-at-5d.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} knocks twice, pauses, knocks once at door 5D, and waits.

knock-at-5d.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} pushes the paper bag through the gap as door 5D opens a crack.

knock-at-5d.1.4.line: {go-between-courier} leaves by the lift, hands empty.

mugger-s-slip.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} arrests {s1-mugger} in the lift lobby late at night.

mugger-s-slip.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} searches the coat of {s1-mugger}, sleeve by sleeve.

mugger-s-slip.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} unfolds a slip from the coat: "Bin, platform 3, 0712 train."

mugger-s-slip.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} points at the slip and holds it up to the lobby light.

mugger-s-slip.1.5.line: {s1-mugger} tells {night-stakeout-officer} the slip came from a runner at the metro.

clerk-s-chair-empty.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} stands at the lost property window, its shutter half down.

clerk-s-chair-empty.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} reads a sign taped to the shutter: "Back soon."

clerk-s-chair-empty.1.3.line: {boss-careless} tells {veteran-officer} the clerk went off sick this morning.

clerk-s-chair-empty.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} asks {boss-careless} the same question a second time, word for word.

log-on-the-screens.1.1.line: {framed-officer} reads a log line on the screens: "Platform 0652, courier scanned, badge {framed-officer}."

log-on-the-screens.1.2.line: {framed-officer} argues with {desk-sergeant}: "I was at the north stair at six fifty-two."

log-on-the-screens.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} points at the paper log on the desk.

log-on-the-screens.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} shrugs at {framed-officer} and turns back to the screens.

log-on-the-screens.1.5.line: {framed-officer} copies the log line word for word into {framed-officer.his} notebook.

lurker-caught.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} keeps watch from the platform stair, a paper cup on the ledge beside {night-stakeout-officer.him}.

lurker-caught.1.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} arrests {s5-lurker} on bench 2 without a chase.

lurker-caught.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} pages through the notebook of {s5-lurker}: columns of train times.

lurker-caught.1.4.line: {s5-lurker} tells {night-stakeout-officer} the times went to the window.

lurker-caught.1.5.line: {night-stakeout-officer} says, to nobody in particular: "Three nights at that stair."

lurker-caught.1.6.line: {boss-careless} waves from the bin as {night-stakeout-officer} walks {s5-lurker} out.

thief-arrested-cousin-on-the-fee.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} arrests {s4-thief} at a sky mall kiosk.

thief-arrested-cousin-on-the-fee.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} pulls a brown envelope from the jacket of {s4-thief}.

thief-arrested-cousin-on-the-fee.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} reads the tags inside the envelope: "P3, lost property."

thief-arrested-cousin-on-the-fee.1.5.line: Posted to the mesh by {extra:cousin}: "Paid it back, Dee."

thief-arrested-cousin-on-the-fee.1.6.line: {red-herring-bath-regular} tells {extra:cousin} the thin bag was the last payment.

flat-5d-opened.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} waits in the stairwell facing door 5D.

flat-5d-opened.1.2.line: {family-caller-officer} on the comm in the lift hall, one side: "Not now, Mama."

flat-5d-opened.1.3.line: {family-caller-officer} leaves the lift hall for ten minutes.

flat-5d-opened.1.4.line: {family-caller-officer} comes back up to the lift hall with a takeout bag.

flat-5d-opened.1.5.line: {red-herring-night-courier} knocks at door 3A before dawn and waits.

flat-5d-opened.1.6.line: Door 3A opens and {red-herring-night-courier} hugs {extra:partner}, flowers and bread in hand.

flat-5d-opened.1.7.line: {go-between-courier} runs down the stairs from 5D two at a time.

flat-5d-opened.1.8.line: {night-stakeout-officer} searches flat 5D: one chair, tag bags, empty drawers.

edit-stamp-at-the-spire.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} walks into the data spire with {rookie-officer.his} notebook.

edit-stamp-at-the-spire.1.2.line: {burnout-officer} sits at a terminal, slumped low in the chair.

edit-stamp-at-the-spire.1.3.line: {burnout-officer} eats noodles from a carton at the terminal.

edit-stamp-at-the-spire.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} reads a log page: "Courier scan 0652. Edited 2215, terminal FD-2."

edit-stamp-at-the-spire.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} points at the edit stamp on the page.

edit-stamp-at-the-spire.1.6.line: {rookie-officer} tells {burnout-officer}: "My notes put that badge at the north stair at six fifty-two."

edit-stamp-at-the-spire.1.7.line: {burnout-officer} shrugs and goes back to the noodle carton.

cabinet-empty-suspension-posted.1.1.line: {inside-officer} on the comm outside the station doors, one side: "Not here. Not tonight."

cabinet-empty-suspension-posted.1.2.line: {inside-officer} goes in and sits at the front desk terminal marked FD-2.

cabinet-empty-suspension-posted.1.3.line: {inside-officer} gets up from the terminal two minutes later and walks out.

cabinet-empty-suspension-posted.2.1.line: {desk-sergeant} and {rookie-officer} search the evidence cabinet: the shelf for the tag bags is empty.

cabinet-empty-suspension-posted.2.2.line: {desk-sergeant} argues with {framed-officer} at the front desk.

cabinet-empty-suspension-posted.2.3.line: Posted to the screens by {desk-sergeant}: "Officer {framed-officer} suspended pending review."

cabinet-empty-suspension-posted.2.4.line: {framed-officer} reads the suspension notice on the screens twice.

cabinet-empty-suspension-posted.2.5.line: {framed-officer} waits outside the station doors, notebook in hand.

found-on-the-lawn.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} walks across the lawn at lunch.

found-on-the-lawn.1.2.line: {informant} sits on a lawn bench in a coat that looks new.

found-on-the-lawn.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} sits down on the same bench beside {informant}.

found-on-the-lawn.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} and {informant} eat side by side on the bench without talking.

found-on-the-lawn.1.5.line: {informant} tells {veteran-officer} the window key was only ever the attendant's.

found-on-the-lawn.1.6.line: {informant} hands {veteran-officer} a book of tag stubs.

found-on-the-lawn.1.7.line: {veteran-officer} walks {informant} back across the lawn to the station.

b-cleared-at-the-spire.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} and {framed-officer} walk into the data spire together.

b-cleared-at-the-spire.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} hands {framed-officer} a page torn from {rookie-officer.his} notebook.

b-cleared-at-the-spire.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} reads the access list aloud: "FD-2 opened 2214," with the badge of the partner of {framed-officer} beside it.

b-cleared-at-the-spire.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} reads the edit stamp below it: "Edited 2215."

b-cleared-at-the-spire.1.5.line: Posted to the screens by {desk-sergeant}: "Correction. Officer {framed-officer} cleared, suspension lifted."

last-train.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} keeps watch from the platform stair before the first train.

last-train.1.2.line: {boss-careless} stands alone at the lost property bin.

last-train.1.3.line: {boss-careless} turns the bin key and lifts the lid.

last-train.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} searches the open bin and pulls out a tagged umbrella.

last-train.1.6.line: {inside-officer} walks onto the platform and stops short.

last-train.1.7.line: {framed-officer} arrests {inside-officer} on the platform, in front of the bin.

last-train.1.8.line: {veteran-officer} hands {rookie-officer} the handheld scanner and the folded beat map.

last-train.1.9.line: {veteran-officer} walks off the platform toward the stairs, hands empty.

care-second-station-shares-scans.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} hands {framed-officer} a printed scan list from station 2.

care-second-station-shares-scans.1.2.line: {framed-officer} reads down the station 2 list, then reads it again.

care-second-station-shares-scans.1.3.line: {framed-officer} points at two matching platform times on the list.

care-same-minute-every-day.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} and {veteran-officer} watch the platform from the stair.

care-same-minute-every-day.1.2.line: {boss-careless} stands at the lost property bin at the same minute as the last two mornings.

care-same-minute-every-day.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} scans the lost property window with the handheld.

care-last-train-early.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} keeps watch from the platform stair before the first train.

care-last-train-early.1.2.line: {boss-careless} turns the bin key and lifts the lid.

care-last-train-early.1.4.line: {inside-officer} walks onto the platform and stops short.

care-last-train-early.1.5.line: {framed-officer} arrests {inside-officer} on the platform, in front of the bin.

care-last-train-early.1.6.line: {veteran-officer} hands {rookie-officer} the handheld scanner and the folded beat map.

care-statement-and-clearing.1.1.line: Posted to the screens by {desk-sergeant}: "Correction. Officer {framed-officer} cleared, suspension lifted."

care-statement-and-clearing.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} hands {framed-officer} a page torn from {rookie-officer.his} notebook.

care-statement-and-clearing.1.3.line: {framed-officer} reads the notebook page once and folds it away.

care-sweeper-s-cart.1.1.line: {go-between-bartender} pushes a sweeping cart along the platform.

care-sweeper-s-cart.1.2.line: {go-between-bartender} stops the cart beside the lost property bin.

care-sweeper-s-cart.1.3.line: {boss-careful} passes a tag stub to {go-between-bartender} across the bin lid.

care-sweeper-s-cart.1.4.line: {go-between-bartender} wheels the cart out through the service door exactly on the half hour.

care-cart-to-the-foundry.1.1.line: {go-between-bartender} walks into the foundry yard without the cart.

care-cart-to-the-foundry.1.2.line: {go-between-bartender} carries a gray bag past the furnace doors.

care-cart-to-the-foundry.1.3.line: {go-between-bartender} knocks once at a foundry room door and waits.

care-cart-to-the-foundry.1.4.line: {go-between-bartender} pushes the gray bag through the gap in the door.

care-cart-to-the-foundry.1.5.line: {go-between-bartender} walks back out of the foundry, hands empty.

care-extra-insider-at-station-2.1.1.line: {inside-officer-extra} sits a little apart from the others at briefing.

care-extra-insider-at-station-2.1.2.line: {inside-officer-extra} steps aside on the comm, one side: "Not here."

care-extra-insider-at-station-2.1.3.line: {inside-officer-extra} is the first one out of the briefing room.

care-extra-insider-at-station-2.1.4.line: {inside-officer-extra} asks {desk-sergeant} what station 1 is working on these days.

care-bags-move-to-the-foundry-room.1.1.line: {go-between-bartender} carries two gray bags across the foundry floor.

care-bags-move-to-the-foundry-room.1.2.line: {go-between-bartender} goes into the foundry room with the bags.

care-bags-move-to-the-foundry-room.1.3.line: {go-between-bartender} waits outside the foundry room door for five minutes.

care-bags-move-to-the-foundry-room.1.4.line: {go-between-bartender} walks out of the foundry with empty hands.

care-last-train-empty-bin.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} keeps watch from the platform stair before the first train.

care-last-train-empty-bin.1.2.line: {boss-careful} stands alone at the lost property bin.

care-last-train-empty-bin.1.3.line: {boss-careful} walks off the platform without turning the bin key.

care-last-train-empty-bin.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} lifts the bin lid and searches inside: it is empty.

care-last-train-empty-bin.1.5.line: {inside-officer} walks onto the platform and stops short.

care-last-train-empty-bin.1.6.line: {framed-officer} arrests {inside-officer} on the platform, in front of the bin.

care-last-train-empty-bin.1.7.line: {veteran-officer} hands {rookie-officer} the handheld scanner and the folded beat map.

care-foundry-room-raid.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} searches the foundry room: gray bags and loose tag stubs.

care-foundry-room-raid.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} points at the green tags spilling from the gray bags.

care-foundry-room-raid.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} carries the gray bags out of the foundry room.

care-closing-night.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} keeps watch from the platform stair in the dark.

care-closing-night.1.2.line: {boss-careful} stands at the lost property bin as the first train pulls in.

care-closing-night.1.3.line: {boss-careful} turns the bin key and lifts the lid.

care-closing-night.1.5.line: {inside-officer-extra} walks onto the platform in a civilian coat.

care-closing-night.1.6.line: {framed-officer} arrests {inside-officer-extra} on the platform before the train doors close.
